data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century, we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on, trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.

We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions. We are actively embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, combining nearly a century of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that were simply not possible before. We exist because travel moves the world, and we move travel. By transforming complexity into clarity and questions into answers, we give our partners the intelligence they need to thrive in an evolving world. For more information visit

ABOUT THE ROLE:

OAG Digital is the team turning our world-class data into a product-led growth engine: a unified experience where customers can discovery, try, pay and use on their own. We build the platform customers use to find, buy and use our data, and the intelligence products that turn that data into answers.

This is the most senior individual contributor role on the technical side of Digital. Its purpose is to turn the Digital strategy into a technical strategy that delivers it: deciding what gets built, in what order and to what standard, so the business can sell what it has committed to sell. A decision taken in one team should still work in another, our promises to customers on access, security, reliability and cost should hold on every channel, and the hardest problems should get solved once.

You’ll work across two areas. Core is the platform backbone: identity, auth, entitlements, billing, usage metering and the infrastructure everything else depends on. Intelligence is the layer above the data: AI-powered insights, predictive models built on Databricks and Snowflake, anomaly detection, and agentic features.

The role is hands-on. You’ll write production code on the hardest parts of the platform while setting direction, reviewing designs and helping other engineers do better work. We care about UX as much as throughput, and we’re AI-native: tooling is part of how we develop, not an afterthought.

This role can be worked remotely from anywhere in the UK only. Please note that we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship, so applicants will need the existing right to work in the UK.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Design and build the hardest parts of the platform, hands on: how customers get to the right data and products, how that access is controlled, and what it costs us to serve. Stay close enough to the code that the design still holds once it’s built
  • Set the technical direction for problems that cross team boundaries: how customers are identified, what they’re allowed to use, how usage is measured and charged, and how existing customers and older systems move onto the new platform. Write the design down, get agreement, and stay with it through delivery so teams build to one approach rather than several
  • Set the standard for products built on AI and machine learning: define what a feature must do before it ships (show where its answer came from, be honest about how current the data is, fail predictably, be tested repeatably). Set the technical brief for data science teams, including how a model will be judged and the speed and cost it has to work within, and push back when a model isn’t the right tool
  • Work with the teams and partners outside Digital who build against your designs, including other parts of OAG and third parties. Share designs early, take feedback, change course where they’re right, and make the call when a cross-team decision has been open too long
  • Integrate AI models, data pipelines and event-driven systems on Databricks and Snowflake into the Intelligence layer
  • Improve how the whole of Digital builds software: review designs and code beyond your own team, mentor senior engineers, and make the good way to do something the easy way. This includes making AI-assisted development reliable, with the checks needed to keep quality high
  • Maintain the quality bar through code reviews, automated testing, observability, and CI/CD.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Extensive experience building and running production software end to end, from system design through to operating it live
  • Technical leadership beyond a single team: a track record of influencing engineers and teams you don’t manage, and building agreement across them
  • System design across boundaries: systems that stay correct, fast and affordable when several teams, several delivery channels and a shared data platform are all involved, and sound judgement on when to solve something once centrally versus letting each team solve it
  • Hands-on experience in analytical or data-intensive contexts and depth in large-scale data platforms: how they’re built, governed and paid for, including keeping one customer’s data separate from another’s, controlling access at the data layer, tracking data lineage, and keeping query cost under control
  • Machine learning and AI in production: enough understanding of how models and agents are built, trained and evaluated to set the technical brief for the data science team, read an evaluation critically, and judge whether a result will hold up in the real world. Experience taking AI-powered features into production and making them reliable, cost-effective and trustworthy for customers.
  • Judgement under uncertainty, with commercial awareness: you understand that technical choices affect what the business can charge and what it costs to serve a customer, and you know when to decide and when to wait
  • Clear communicator who can explain direction, risk and trade-offs so that engineers, product, commercial and senior leaders all take away the same thing
  • A builder’s mindset. You understand the who and the why, and you own what ships
  • AI-native in how you build: you use AI tooling with judgement, stay current with how agentic development is evolving, and help make effective agentic practices the norm across the team

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

WE WILL OFFER YOU

🚀 A progressive, non-hierarchical culture where innovation drives everything we build

🏡 Flexible working arrangements that allow remote work or office attendance

💰 An attractive compensation and benefits package, including access to a Simplyhealth cash plan to support your everyday health and wellbeing, a company bonus scheme, Octopus EV salary sacrifice scheme and enhanced pension scheme

🏖️ 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, volunteering days and additional day off during your birthday month

👪 Inclusive family benefits designed to support you through parenthood and fertility journeys

🌍 Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year

📚 Annual learning and development budget.

OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.

We are seeking an experienced SAP TM Architect/Consultant to design, implement, and optimize robust transportation management solutions.

In this permanent role, you will be instrumental in shaping the transportation management landscape, driving innovation, and ensuring the successful delivery of critical projects. You will work closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and external partners to gather requirements, design scalable solutions, and implement best practices within the SAP TM framework.

As an SAP TM Architect/Consultant, you will be a key player in our digital transformation journey, directly impacting operational efficiency and business performance.This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned professional looking to make a significant impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of SAP TM solutions, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.
  • Conduct detailed business process analysis and translate complex requirements into functional specifications and system designs.
  • Provide expert guidance on SAP TM functionalities, including freight order management, freight settlement, charge management, and transportation planning.
  • Collaborate with technical teams for custom developments, integrations (e.g., with SAP ECC/S/4HANA, EWM, EM, GTS), and data migration activities.
  • Perform system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT) support, and provide training to end-users.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex SAP TM issues, providing ongoing support and system enhancements.
  • Act as a subject matter expert, staying current with SAP TM innovations and industry trends to recommend strategic improvements.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation, including functional specifications, configuration guides, and test plans
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience as an SAP TM Consultant or Architect.
  • Proven expertise in multiple SAP TM modules and functionalities (e.g., Freight Order, Freight Settlement, Charge Management, Planning, Optimization).
  • Strong understanding of integration points between SAP TM and other SAP modules (e.g., SD, MM, FI/CO, EWM, EM, S/4HANA).
  • Experience in at least 2 full lifecycle SAP TM implementations, including blueprinting, configuration, testing, and go-live support.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

data.title: AI Engineer - 4 Day Week + Remote
data.description:
Ever wondered how it would be to revolutionise one of the least digitised industries in the market, alongside a growing and switched-on team? Read on!

___________________________________________________________________________________

We are Shape.Construction!

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION

It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP.

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it).

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better.

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management. (Check out Shape, our construction management tech and watch this video about what we are doing)

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. (Read more about our vision and mission).

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 200 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job”, it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life:

- Connects us with meaningful relationships

- Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans

- Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.

We are achieving this vision through the following two missions: 

1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation

2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

Laminar Projects is proud to be recognized as one of the UK’s Best Workplaces in Construction, Engineering & Property™ for 2024! Join a team where learning, collaboration, and growth are at the core of everything we do, and where solving big challenges is part of the fun.

___________________________________________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

We are looking for an AI Engineer who combines deep knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) with strong software engineering skills and a pragmatic approach to product development. This person will help us design, build and deploy AI-powered features across Shape App and Channels, working closely with the Product and SRE Teams to define optimal solutions and ensure they run reliably in production.

You should be excited by the challenge of turning AI potential into real, useful features, for construction teams, and you should know when a small, lean approach is better than a large, complex one.

Team

You will join a team of product-minded software engineers, designers, and strategists focused on improving the way construction projects are delivered. You will work closely with Product Managers to shape AI features, and with our SRE Team to ensure production-readiness. You will be the go-to expert on AI/LLMs and play a key role in shaping our AI capability.

Your top 3 objectives

1. Design Lean, Fit-for-Purpose AI Solutions: Choose and implement the most appropriate AI/LLM approach for each use case, balancing quality, performance and cost.

2. Integrate AI-features into our Applications: From exploration and prototyping to production deployment and iteration, using prompt engineering, model selection, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

3. Prepare for Production: Work with SREs to ensure AI features are reliable, scalable, observable, and secure in production.

Your top 5 responsibilities

1. Understand the Product Context: Work with product teams to translate user needs into clear AI opportunities and technical requirements.

2. Own the AI Feature Lifecycle: From exploration and prototyping to production deployment and iteration, using prompt engineering, model selection, fine-tuning and evaluation.

3. Build AI-Backed Features: Contribute production-grade code that integrates AI capabilities into our apps, working alongside other engineers.

4. Guide Production Set-Up: Collaborate with SREs to define what infrastructure, observability, and scaling is required for each AI feature.

5. Stay Pragmatic and Up-to-Date: Continuously explore new development in LLMs and generative AI but always apply them with a product-first mindset.

Your Capabilities

You are a software engineer who understands how to use LLMs effectively, not just how to train them. You work well with ambiguity and know how to test your ideas quickly. You're comfortable collaborating with product teams and setting up production-grade systems.

As a candidate, you should have:

- Strong experience in applying LLMs and generative AI to real-world problems.

- Solid foundation in Phyton and ML frameworks (e.g. LangChain, Transformers, OpenAI APIs, etc.).

- Experience with multi-model evaluation and feedback loops.

- Production experience with embeddings, vector dabatases (like Pinecone, Weaviate or FAISS), and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures.

- Familiarity with MLOps tooling and observability for inference pipelines.

- A bias for simplicity, clarity, and iterative delivery.

- The ability to communicate clearly with engineers, designers and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have (If you don’t have it now you will after joining)

- Familiarity with production environments, APIs, and containerised systems (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Participation in AI communities, papers or OSS projects.

Shape isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:

- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge

- You like to be the smartest person in the room

- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback

- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

At Shape we value diverse experiences and perspectives, empowering each member to contribute their unique expertise towards our collective success, so if you don't think you meet all the criteria but still are excited about this role we encourage you to apply anyways!

___________________________________________________________________________________

Salary and Benefits

Standard Stuff

- Competitive salary dependent on location and capability

- Paid Annual Leave (Number of days will depend on where you are based) + statutory Bank Holidays

- In-House Coaching Sessions

- Discretionary bonus scheme for all team members.

The Life-Changing Stuff

- 4 Day Weeks: That’s right, 4 day weeks

- Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.

- Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Shape exists

- Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Shape. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Shape, development is unbounded

- Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

________________________________________________________________________________________

Application

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:

- Why do you want to join us?

- If you joined, where do you think you could make the most impact and how?

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders.

In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

Compensation

Additional Information

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/ai-engineer-4-day-week-remote-laminar-projects

data.title: Engineering Director, EU
data.description:
We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London or Remote (UK) | Base salary £170k - £225k + Equity + Benefits

Engineering at Monzo

Monzo has successfully launched in Ireland and is expanding across Europe. We're now entering the next phase of our journey: building and scaling a multi-market European bank.

The EU Engineering organisation sits at the centre of that ambition. We are responsible for helping Monzo launch, grow and operate across Europe, navigating everything from product-market fit and customer growth to regulatory requirements, localisation and operational scale.

Unlike most engineering organisations at Monzo, EU does not own a single product area. We work horizontally across the company, partnering with teams across Payments, Core Banking, Growth, Wealth, Customer Operations, Fincrime, Platform and many others to bring Monzo's products to new markets and deliver great customer experiences locally.

As an Engineering Director, you'll lead a distributed engineering organisation across the UK, Spain and remote locations. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance and executive stakeholders to solve complex problems that span organisational boundaries.

Success in this role comes through influence, relationships and organisational leadership as much as execution. You'll need to build alignment across a wide range of teams, create clarity in ambiguity, and help Monzo discover what works in new markets while establishing the foundations that allow us to scale across Europe.

This is one of Monzo's most strategically important areas and a unique opportunity to help build a European bank from the ground up.

What you’ll work on

  • Lead a distributed engineering organisation spanning multiple squads, markets and countries.
  • Build and develop Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, Operations, Risk and Compliance leaders to define and execute Monzo's European strategy.
  • Drive alignment and execution across numerous collectives to ensure Europe receives the capabilities it needs to succeed.
  • Shape how Monzo approaches market expansion, localisation, regulatory requirements and multi-market product development.
  • Influence priorities and outcomes across teams that do not directly report to you.
  • Create clarity and momentum in highly ambiguous problem spaces where ownership and solutions are not always obvious.
  • Design and evolve organisational structures, operating models and planning processes that allow Monzo to scale effectively across Europe.
  • Help identify and validate product-market fit in new markets while balancing short-term delivery and long-term strategic investments.
  • Partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of Monzo's European business.

You should apply if

  • You have experience leading large engineering organisations through other leaders, including Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior individual contributors.
  • You have successfully operated in highly complex organisations where outcomes depend on collaboration across many teams and functions.
  • You are exceptional at building relationships and influencing without direct authority.
  • You can navigate ambiguity and create clarity where goals, ownership or priorities are not yet fully defined.
  • You have experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth, organisational change or market expansion.
  • You enjoy solving organisational and business problems, not just technical ones.You can balance strategy and execution, translating ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.
  • You are comfortable making decisions in environments where there is rarely a perfect answer.
  • You have a strong track record of building high-performing leadership teams and developing future leaders.
  • You are energised by the challenge of building something new and helping shape the future of Monzo's international expansion.

The interview process

After an informal ~30 min recruiter call our interview process involves 2 main stages:

  1. Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our senior engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)
  2. Loop Stage - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as execution and leadership interviews.

At all stages we’ll create space for you to ask as many questions as you have, you’re interviewing us as well!

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.

How we work :

Locations & Flexible Working :

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays ️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. ✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo!

What’s in it for you

Base salary £170k - £225k + Equity + Benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK

✅ We can sponsor visas

This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage

data.description:
Headquarters: Remote, US

About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the Team

The Customer Value Architects team sits inside the revenue organization and owns the connection between what customers buy and what they actually get out of Mixpanel. We turn product usage into measurable business outcomes, working across onboarding, adoption, and renewal to make sure customers see the value they signed up for.

About the Role

The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who connects a customer's Mixpanel investment to real outcomes for a defined book of accounts. You'll own the adoption and value plan for each account end to end: understanding why the customer bought Mixpanel, tracking whether they're getting the ROI they expected, and driving the enablement and product usage that gets them there. You'll build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, partner closely with your Account Executive and renewal counterparts, and bring a growing point of view on how customers should think about AI in their product workflows. This role suits someone who can own a project end to end and is ready to start extending their influence beyond their own accounts to the wider team.

Responsibilities

  • Own the value plan for each account in your portfolio, connecting the business problem that led the customer to buy Mixpanel with the outcomes they measure.
  • Build relationships with business and technical stakeholders, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to what customers care about most.
  • Run discovery on customer priorities and pain points, and turn what you learn into concrete adoption plans and internal updates.
  • Partner with your Account Executive on expansion and your renewal counterpart on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that supports both.
  • Lead enablement/best practices sessions on dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling to grow how deeply and widely a customer uses Mixpanel.
  • Monitor usage and health signals and lead business reviews that surface what's working, deepen adoption, and catch risk early.
  • Spot underused features and contracted capabilities, and turn them into clear recommendations for the customer.
  • Triage product questions and issues, solving what you can and routing the rest to the right team.
  • Build a working point of view on a customer's AI maturity, and use Mixpanel's own AI surface to help them build on their product data.
  • Coordinate with GTM, Product, and Engineering on escalations, and share what works with the broader Customer Value Architects team.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • 4 - 6 years of experience in customer success, consulting, or a related field supporting B2B SaaS accounts, or equivalent experience.
  • A track record of managing relationships across a range of stakeholders, from business partners to technical teams.
  • The ability to translate technical concepts, like data models and product metrics, into terms that land with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience turning product usage into a clear story about customer outcomes and ROI.
  • Comfort building and running adoption plans that tie daily work to a customer's larger goals.
  • Hands-on experience with AI or agentic tooling beyond casual use, such as MCP-based workflows or LLM copilots.
  • A collaborative approach to working across account teams and internal partners to move plans forward.
  • Good judgment for prioritizing which accounts and actions need attention first.

Bonus Points For

  • Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development.
  • Experience in a technical advisory or professional services capacity.
  • Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling.

#LI-Remote

Benefits and Perks

  • Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care
  • Mental Wellness Benefit
  • Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays
  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

  • Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who connects a customer's Mixpanel investment to real outcomes for a defined book of accounts. data.title: Senior Network Engineer
data.description:
Leidos is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to support Federal Civil customer in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.

LOCATION: This position is remote; however, prefer candidates that are within driving distance to the Washington, DC area.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior Network Engineer will serve as a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, implementing, optimizing, and sustaining complex network solutions spanning on-premises infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments. The position requires technical expertise, independent problem-solving, and the ability to develop effective solutions to complex network challenges involving multiple technologies and technical disciplines. The successful candidate will collaborate with customer stakeholders, engineering teams, cybersecurity professionals, and program leadership to maintain network availability, performance, and security while supporting infrastructure modernization and evolving mission requirements. This role also provides technical guidance to other engineers and contributes to network architecture, engineering standards, and continuous operational improvement.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must have or able to obtain a Public Trust clearance; Must be a US Citizen.

PRIMARY RESPONSBILITIES:

  • Serve as a Senior technical and escalation resource for complex network engineering and operational issues affecting mission-critical enterprise infrastructure.
  • Lead the planning, design, implementation, and optimization of complex network infrastructure solutions across geographically distributed, multi-vendor environments.
  • Independently analyze complex technical challenges involving multiple systems and disciplines, develop engineering solutions, and implement corrective actions that improve network reliability, performance, and security.
  • Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise routing and switching infrastructure, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, routing redundancy, and network failover.
  • Engineer and support enterprise network security solutions, including Cisco Firepower, Firepower Management Center (FMC), ASA, firewall policies, access controls, and security hardening.
  • Design, implement, and sustain secure site-to-site and remote-access VPN solutions, including Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect and connectivity with external partners and vendors.
  • Engineer and maintain hybrid cloud network connectivity integrating on-premises infrastructure with AWS networking services, including VPCs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and load balancing.
  • Support enterprise wireless networking and network access control technologies, including Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
  • Lead technical planning and execution of network infrastructure upgrades, modernization initiatives, lifecycle replacements, and security remediation activities.
  • Evaluate network performance, availability, capacity, and emerging technical requirements; recommend and implement improvements to strengthen service delivery and operational resilience.
  • Lead complex incident investigations and root cause analysis, identifying systemic issues and developing sustainable corrective and preventive solutions.
  • Collaborate with customer representatives, program leadership, cybersecurity teams, vendors, and service providers to assess requirements, develop technical solutions, and influence network engineering decisions.
  • Develop and maintain network architecture documentation, configuration standards, technical implementation plans, and operational procedures.
  • Support incident, problem, change, and service request management processes while ensuring technical accuracy, documentation, and operational accountability.
  • Provide technical mentorship, peer review, and engineering guidance to junior and mid-level network engineers.
  • Identify opportunities for network automation, standardization, and process improvement to increase operational efficiency, reliability, and security.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field with 8+ years of relevant network engineering experience; additional education and experience equivalencies may be considered.
  • Advanced hands-on experience designing, implementing, administering, and troubleshooting complex enterprise network infrastructure in production environments.
  • Expert-level knowledge of enterprise routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, and network redundancy and failover.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing technical solutions to complex network problems involving multiple systems, technologies, or engineering disciplines.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise network security infrastructure, including firewalls, access control policies, and VPN connectivity.
  • Experience supporting Cisco and/or Juniper enterprise networking platforms in complex, multi-vendor environments.
  • Experience designing, implementing, or supporting hybrid cloud network connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and AWS environments.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex network troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective action efforts.
  • Experience planning and executing network infrastructure changes, upgrades, and security remediation activities in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop technical recommendations, communicate complex technical information, and collaborate with customer stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors, and service providers.
  • Experience producing and maintaining network diagrams, technical documentation, configuration standards, and implementation procedures.
  • Strong communication skills, with experience collaborating directly with customers, vendors, and ISPs to support network design, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Hands-on experience with Juniper EX/QFX & Junos OS, Cisco ISR & IOS devices, ASA, Firepower & FMC.
  • Demonstrated experience with routing/switching protocols (e.g., BGP, `OSPF, VRF) and core infrastructure services.
  • Hands-on experience managing AWS network infrastructure and hybrid cloud connectivity (e.g., VPC, direct-connect, transit gateways, load balancers) between on-prem and cloud environments.
  • Experience with remote access VPN solutions, including Cisco AnyConnect/Secure Client configuration and support.
  • Experience with virtual computing/virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware/vSphere) as they relate to network design and connectivity.
  • Experience with wireless infrastructure and NAC solutions (e.g., Cisco ISE).
  • Experience with Cisco CUCM/UC voice solutions.
  • Able to obtain a baseline 8140 certification [(IAT Level II) CCNA-Security, CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, Security+ CE, CND, SSCP] within 90 days.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Cisco Certified CCNA
  • Cisco Certified CCNP or Juniper JNCIP-ENT.
  • Experience with Cisco Meraki wireless solutions.
  • Experience with Cisco ISE.
  • Experience with Dell switches and OS10.
  • Experience with ServiceNow.
  • Security+ CE certification.

***Candidates selected for an interview should note that it will be conducted live via video, with cameras on at all times. As part of our identity verification process, a photo will be taken during the interview to confirm your identity and help protect against fraud. At hire, candidates complete formal identity verification.***

data.title: Principal Architect, AI/ML
data.description:
Zencore is a fast-growing company founded by former Google Cloud leaders, architects, and engineers. We are seeking candidates with significant experience in Google Cloud to join our team. Our engagements aim to eliminate obstacles, reduce risk, and accelerate timelines for customers transitioning to Google and seeking assistance with data and application modernization. We embed within customer teams to provide strategic guidance, facilitate technology decisions, and execute projects in a collaborative, co-development style.

As a member of our Cloud Engineering team, you will be working with fast-paced innovative companies, leveraging AI as the key driver of their transformation. Our clients will look to you as their trusted advisor, someone they can rely on and who will be there to help them along their AI journey. You will be expected to cover a large spectrum of technology topics like model optimization, high-performance training on specialized hardware (TPUs), efficient model serving (vLLM), MLOps, and complex agentic systems.

At Zencore, a Principal Architect is a key technical leader in our engineering organization and acts as an ambassador of our technical and cloud engineering expertise. Principal Architects at Zencore are able to navigate a broad technical range but are specialized in one or more domains. They are responsible for the technical oversight and end-to-end delivery of projects within our professional services business.

Whilst this is remote role, we are only considering US based candidates and do not offer visa sponsorship.

What you will do...

    • Serve as Zencore’s senior-most technical authority on the practical application of advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning.
    • Partner with the sales and business development teams in a pre-sales capacity to scope opportunities, design solutions for proposals, and act as the senior technical voice in client pitches.
    • Lead the architecture and design of sophisticated, secure, and scalable AI solutions for our clients, moving beyond standard API integrations to create genuine competitive advantages.
    • Collaborate closely with Cloud & Data Architects to guarantee the design and deployment of comprehensive client solutions.
    • Address the growing demand for private, data-sovereign AI by designing systems that meet strict GDPR and data privacy requirements. Strive for model explainability and bias mitigation, ensuring solutions adhere to ethical standards and safety guardrails.
    • Architect solutions for hosting, fine-tuning, and optimizing both proprietary (e.g., Gemini, Claude) and open-source (e.g., Llama, Mistral) models on hyperscaler platforms.
    • Lead clients in selecting optimal cloud-native technologies, prioritizing Google Cloud solutions for deploying and scaling production-grade agentic systems.
    • Guide and mentor customers and Zencore's engineering teams on advanced topics, establishing best practices for high-performance training (PyTorch, JAX, TPUs), efficient model serving (vLLM), and complex agentic systems (LangGraph, Langchain, Google ADK).
    • Devise the financial architecture of AI solutions by performing ROI analysis and implementing cost-optimization strategies to ensure large-scale deployments remain economically sustainable for customers.
    • Act as an external thought leader, contributing to the Zencore brand through blog posts, conference presentations, and community engagement.
    • Act as a "player-coach," providing hands-on leadership and fostering a culture of deep technical excellence in AI/ML.

Who we need...

    • Master’s degree in Computer Science, natural sciences, mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience in designing and delivering high-scale AI/ML systems.
    • Extensive experience in a senior or principal architect role with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex, production-grade machine learning systems that have created measurable business value.
    • Deep, hands-on architectural experience with at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure) is required.
    • Direct, hands-on experience with Google Cloud (Vertex AI, GKE, TPUs) is a significant plus.
    • Proven expertise in LLM optimization, including techniques for quantization, pruning, efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), and high-performance serving (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM).
    • Hands-on experience with high-performance ML frameworks (e.g., JAX, PyTorch/XLA) for training or fine-tuning large-scale models.
    • Expertise in designing and deploying agentic workflows using both code-centric (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, Google ADK) and low-code (e.g., Vertex AI Agent Builder, LangSmith Agent Builder) paradigms.
    • A strong understanding of the architectural patterns required for building secure, private, and data-sovereign AI solutions.
    • Experience with LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (e.g., LangSmith, LangFuse, Vertex AI Evaluation).
    • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts and their business value to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • A passion for mentoring and a drive for continuous learning in the fast-evolving AI landscape.

We are a fully remote company and offer competitive compensation and benefits.

Zencore is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Zencore is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. The PlanetScale platform offers both Postgres and Vitess clusters. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our core engineering team and help us build the next generation of database infrastructure.

What's the job to be done?

  • You will advise and handle support requests from enterprise customers on the PlanetScale platform.
  • You will become a customer-facing subject-matter expert for enterprise customers on the PlanetScale platform.
  • You will identify product gaps in a customer-specific context and work with Technical Account Management, Engineering and Sales Engineering teams to prioritize and escalate them.
  • You will be part of an on call rotation for high priority issues.

These attributes best describe you…

  • You are comfortable in front of customers, empathetic but understanding when to push back to help customers become successful on their own.
  • You have excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills; with a mix of enough experience and intuition to zero in on root-causes for bugs that can leave others stumped.

Be it delving into unfamiliar code in Vitess, one of its dependencies, or a random MySQL connector, written in a language you may not know (yet!). Working with code as your main source of documentation doesn't fluster you, and you are happy to help add/correct it as necessary where it may be inaccurate.

Experience with Kubernetes Platform Engineering (EKS, AKS, RH OCP/OPP, Rancher)

data.title: Senior Detection & Response Engineer
data.description:
Headquarters: Remote

You're the detection engineer people turn to when they ask "what does Microsoft actually see here?" Not the marketing-slide answer, the real map. Which product emits which telemetry, any anticipated ingestion lags, what table or API it lands in, which license tier gates it, how long it survives before it ages out, and where the documentation quietly disagrees with reality. When a new technique drops, your first instinct is to ask which Microsoft signal would catch it, and whether customers have it switched on.

You also know Microsoft never sits still. Hunting tables appear, columns get renamed, Graph versions retire, capability shuffles between SKUs, previews go GA, features quietly vanish, and native alert logic shifts underneath you. You've got a repeatable way of staying ahead of that churn instead of finding out when a detection stops firing. You're comfortable behind a command line and in front of a customer, including scenarios where the conversation isn’t pleasant. If that's you, we'd love to talk! We have an amazing team and believe you'll love getting to know us.

At Expel, we help businesses bridge the cybersecurity talent gap by providing transparent Managed Detection and Response. To do this we build technology to make sure our security analysts are solving important problems, and automation is helping them make better decisions at every step. We delight in using technology to make security accessible for our customers.

What Expel can do for you

  • Make you one of our recognized authorities on Microsoft detection and response — for our SOC, our engineers, our go-to-market teams, and our customers
  • Give you real ownership of Expel's detection coverage across the whole Microsoft security estate
  • Put Microsoft telemetry from across our customer base in front of you — a breadth of real-world environments no single enterprise gets to see
  • Let you write and tune detections in our own rule engine and watch them run against live signal
  • Treat AI tooling (Claude Code and friends) as a first-class part of how you work, not a side experiment
  • Enable you to learn from analysts, data scientists, engineers, and responders responsible for various components of Expel's product and services
  • Provide access to popular EDR, network, SIEM, identity, and cloud technologies well beyond the Microsoft stack
  • Challenge you to push the boundaries of our security vision

What you can do for Expel

  • Own our detection coverage across Defender XDR, Entra ID, Sentinel, Microsoft Graph, Azure, and Microsoft 365 — from raw signal through to shipped, tuned detections
  • Build and maintain a living map of Microsoft security signal: what exists, known ingestion lag, where it lands, what gates it, how long it's kept, and how far you can trust it
  • Track how that signal changes and turn every material change into a concrete action — catching drift before it costs us efficacy
  • Tell us where Microsoft's native detections are strong enough to lean on, where they're noisy or shallow, and where Expel needs its own layer
  • Make SOC analysts faster by automating Microsoft-specific investigative workflows against the Graph, Defender, Sentinel, and Entra APIs
  • Partner with Engineering on our Microsoft integrations — ingestion, API limits and throttling, and schema mapping
  • Answer the hard questions from the SOC, CS, and Sales — and mentor the people asking them
  • Help customers understand what they're actually covered for, what they're missing, and what turning it on would buy them

What you should bring with you

  • Deep, current, hands-on knowledge of the Microsoft security stack — Defender XDR (Endpoint, Identity, Office 365, Cloud Apps), Entra ID, Sentinel, Microsoft Graph, and the Azure and Microsoft 365 control and data planes
  • Fluency in KQL: you can write, read, optimize, and debug non-trivial hunting queries across both Defender Advanced Hunting and Sentinel, and you know how and why the two schemas differ
  • Working knowledge of the Graph and Graph Security APIs, the Defender and Sentinel APIs, and their authentication, permission, versioning, and throttling models
  • A strong grasp of the Entra ID (and legacy Active Directory) identity attack surface — authentication flows, conditional access, OAuth application consent, token theft and replay, hybrid identity and sync, privileged role abuse — and the telemetry each produces
  • Solid understanding of Windows internals and command line tooling, with enough macOS and Linux to keep up with Defender's cross-platform coverage
  • Experience writing, deploying, and tuning custom detections against Microsoft data sets, plus enough non-Microsoft exposure (AWS, GCP, other EDR and SIEM) to keep perspective
  • Proficiency with Python and Sigma, and real fluency using Anthropic tools such as Claude Code to work across systems and data (locally, via MCP, and so on)
  • 5+ years in information technology or security operations, with substantial time spent defending or operating Microsoft environments
  • Excellent tact and diplomacy skills — you can explain Microsoft's limits to an audience that doesn't want to hear about them
  • SC-200, AZ-500, or SC-300 are a plus; demonstrated depth matters considerably more

Work Location

Our headquarters is in Herndon, Virginia. However, we realize that while there is a benefit to in-person interaction, good people don’t all live in Northern Virginia. Remote work is an option for this role.

Additional Notes

The base salary range for this role is between $142,900 USD and $207,200 USD + bonus eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $160,000 and $192,000 based on experience, skills, and market data.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer: You’ll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

#LI-Remote

Forward Deployed Engineer / Implementation Engineer

Remote, Montreal, QC, Canada. Full time.
Must be located in QC, Canada. Travel up to 25 percent: team meetings, customer site visits when a customer asks for one, and occasional industry events.

About CWS

CWS builds and runs the security and cloud infrastructure companies depend on. We design, deploy, tune and operate production platforms across Montreal, QC, Canada: SIEM onboarding and detection engineering, cloud identity and access, edge and firewall platforms, security programs, data protection, and secure cloud environments built as code. We do not hand off at go-live. We run the managed service on top of what we build, so the systems we deploy stay tuned and defensible.

We work through technology partners and directly with customers. Every engineer here works directly with the founders and owns a real customer outcome from day one.

Role & Responsibilities

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own the customer engagement end to end: you scope the work, architect the solution, build and configure it, prove it holds up, and hand over a system the customer's team can run without you. You are both the engineer and the person accountable for the result.

You carry one to three engagements at a time, spanning cloud and infrastructure delivery (AWS, Google Cloud, infrastructure as code, networking, edge and firewall platforms) and security delivery (tool implementation, tuning, and assessments).

  • Deploy, configure and integrate security and cloud platforms in customer environments, and prove they work before you hand them over.
  • Plan and run your engagements: milestones, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and a weekly status the customer can read in two minutes.
  • Raise risks early, and bring options and a recommendation with them.
  • Write the as-built documentation and runbooks, run the knowledge transfer, and train the customer's team so they can operate without you.
  • Contribute to managed-service work on platforms we run: health checks, tuning, and renewal assessments.
  • Help scope new work: effort estimates, technical input to statements of work, and kickoff material.
  • After each engagement, write down what changed between the plan and what it took, and turn it into an asset the team reuses.

Qualifications

  • Three to five years in security engineering, DevSecOps or platform engineering, or software engineering, including at least one year delivering into environments you did not own.
  • Hands-on AWS, and working knowledge of Azure or Google Cloud: identity, networking, compute, storage, logging.
  • Networking you can troubleshoot: DNS, routing, VPN, firewalls, load balancing, TLS.
  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) and version control as daily habits.
  • Python or TypeScript at a level where you build your own tooling.
  • Security fundamentals across identity, endpoint, network and cloud posture, and the ability to explain a finding to a non-technical owner.
  • Clear written and spoken English. You write your own status updates, as-builts and runbooks.
  • Comfort working on your own. You take an ambiguous problem, break it down, decide what to build and what to configure, and ask for help early when you need it.

You do not need to match every line. If you meet most of them and you learn fast, apply.

Nice to have:

  • Certifications: a cloud provider certification (security specialty preferred), a firewall or edge platform certification, a SIEM or security operations certification, CISSP, Security+ or a GIAC certification, or Kubernetes.
  • Delivery experience in a consulting, professional services or managed security firm, where you owned a schedule and a customer relationship.
  • French, spoken and written. Part of our delivery is in French.
  • Detection engineering or security automation.
  • Compliance context: SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS.

Compensation and benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • Dedicated mental health days
  • Performance bonuses
  • Learning and certification stipend
  • Home office equipment

data.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Partner Solutions Architect, Strategic Partnerships, you'll own the technical strategy and validation of joint work with GitLab's strategic partners: hyperscalers, artificial intelligence (AI) labs, AI-native companies, and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) vendors. You'll work with partners, Product, and Research and Development (R&D) to turn partner and customer needs into integrations, influence product design, and build the business case for each joint effort, from the first architecture review to a shipped integration. In this role you will also own the AI model evaluation process with our model partners, working closely with our R&D teams to assess new models ahead of release and ensure GitLab is built on the best-performing models for our customers. Unlike a customer-facing Solutions Architect role focused on adoption, you'll work with partners to make GitLab better. This role has no sales quota or variable pay.

At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Our platform doesn't just bring people together-it unites teams and organizations, breaking down barriers and redefining what's possible in software development.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end technical strategy for assigned strategic partners, connecting technical requirements with joint business objectives.
  • Turn partner technology and roadmaps into integration, architecture, and product opportunities across the GitLab platform, from planning to monitoring and AI agents and model integrations.
  • Resolve complex technical issues across GitLab and partner systems, including cloud architecture, tool integrations, and AI model and agent evaluation and integration. Build working prototypes to validate concepts with partners.
  • Manage the end-to-end AI model evaluation process with our model partners, coordinating with R&D to secure early access, align on evaluation criteria and timelines, and translate results into partnership and product roadmap decisions.
  • Design and facilitate partner workshops, architecture reviews, and cloud financial management (FinOps) sessions, bringing in the right participants and documenting outcomes and next steps.
  • Build business cases for joint technical efforts, defining expected gains, costs, and resources, and securing agreement from partner managers, R&D, and leadership.
  • Bring partner requirements and technical feedback into Product and R&D discussions to influence product design and the roadmap.
  • Coordinate Engineering, Product, FinOps, Finance, Sales, and Marketing with partner technical teams to move joint work from evaluation to delivery.
  • Track cloud, AI, and DevSecOps developments to advise partnership investment, and share reusable findings through documentation, the handbook, reference architectures, and technical content.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience as a Senior Solutions Architect, Partner Solutions Architect, Partner Engineer, or in a similar senior technical role. Experience with technology partners or alliances is strongly preferred.
  • An end-to-end understanding of the software development lifecycle, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and DevSecOps, with the ability to use GitLab in depth.
  • Hands-on cloud architecture experience with at least one hyperscaler: Google Cloud, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure. Cloud cost or FinOps experience is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of AI model evaluation frameworks and agent technology, including large language model (LLM) application programming interfaces (APIs), agent frameworks, and Model Context Protocol (MCP), and how they fit into developer workflows.
  • Experience designing and facilitating technical workshops with senior technical and business stakeholders, and building business cases that scope work, estimate gains and costs, and size resources.
  • An autonomous, ownership-driven approach: you identify work and move it forward without waiting for a project backlog.
  • Clear, concise written and spoken communication, adapting technical and commercial trade-offs for audiences from engineers to executives.
  • Ability to travel about once a quarter and work hours that overlap with Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). If you're on the US West Coast, expect to start around 7 a.m. Pacific Time; when the day ends is flexible.

About the team

You'll join Strategic Partnerships and report to the VP, Corporate Development and Strategic Partnerships. The team manages GitLab's relationships with hyperscalers, AI companies, and select DevSecOps companies, acting as the business owner and coordinating work across hosting contracts, product integrations, go-to-market activities, purchasing, and partner-specific marketing. Partner managers and directors lead each relationship; you'll own the technical side across partner types and collaborate with R&D, Engineering, FinOps, Finance, Sales, and Marketing. The role is remote, with Eastern Time preferred and other US time zones possible.

data.description:
Documo is on a mission to help businesses digitize and streamline their document workflows. As a fast-growing B2B SaaS company, our platform makes it easier to handle unstructured files like faxes and forms through tools like Intelligent Document Processing - turning messy paperwork into structured, usable data. We believe great products start with great people. That’s why we invest in top talent, value strong culture, and prioritize customer success and design excellence.

If you’re excited to do impactful work and want to grow with a team that values innovation, collaboration, and purpose - we’d love to meet you!

Job title Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote)

Team Engineering

Department function

The Engineering Department is crucial in designing, developing, and maintaining our company's software products. Our department manages critical areas such as development, infrastructure, operations, quality assurance, and product management, collaborating to provide reliable, secure, and scalable technology solutions.

Our primary objective is to build and sustain software products that satisfy customer needs and align with our long-term business strategy. The department is instrumental in researching and integrating new technologies to enhance our internal products and operations. We are also responsible for ensuring our products meet the company's IT, information security, and compliance program requirements.

Department Responsibilities

  • Providing the strategic technical direction for the business
  • Architecting, developing, and maintaining Documo’s software product catalog in collaboration with the Product Team, internal stakeholders, and customers
  • Ensuring technology solutions meet high standards for reliability, security, and scalability
  • Maintaining technical documentation and procedures to ensure the effective development, maintenance, and support of software products
  • Researching and implementing new technologies that improve internal operations
  • Implementing requirements to satisfy information technology, information security, and compliance programs
  • Providing escalated technical support to customers and internal stakeholders as needed

Reports to Engineering Manager, DevOps

Direct reports None

Key Relationships

Internal: Applied AI, Customer Success, Development, Information Security, Product Management, Quality Assurance, System Architects

External: Cloud and tooling vendors, compliance auditors, and customer technical stakeholders as needed for escalations and integrations

Role Purpose

The Senior DevOps Engineer designs, builds, and operates the cloud platform that runs Documo's document processing and fax products, including the infrastructure behind our AI and machine learning services. You will own how code gets from a pull request to production, how production stays healthy, and how the platform scales securely as our product catalog and AI workloads grow.

You will bring 6+ years of DevOps, site reliability, or platform engineering experience, use AI tools in your daily work, treat infrastructure as a product, and act as a technical lead who mentors other engineers.

This role can be up to 10% customer-facing, mainly escalations, connectivity and integration discussions, and security reviews.

Why join Documo?

  • Competitive U.S. benefits: medical, dental, vision, and a 401(k) with a strong match.

  • Annual bonus program based on role and company performance.

  • Annual performance reviews with merit increases.

  • In-person company kick-off to connect, collaborate, and celebrate.

  • Equity opportunities to grow with us.

  • Flexible remote work that fits your life, plus flexible paid time off.

  • Competitive paid parental leave, mental health support, and Employee Assistance Programs (EAP).

  • Be part of a small, fast-growing tech company with a supportive, inclusive, and fun culture.

We celebrate differences.
Documo welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, especially those underrepresented in tech. We do not discriminate based on ancestry, race, place of origin, political belief, religion, marital or family status, physical or mental ability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other legally protected characteristic. Documo is an equal opportunity employer.

To be considered for this position, applicants must submit a resume that includes their full name, current residential address, email address, and phone number. Resumes that do not contain all required contact information will not be considered.

Why You’ll Love This Role WoodmenLife is seeking an experienced Cloud Engineer III to help design, build, and evolve our Azure cloud platform. This senior technical role is highly impactful—driving platform engineering maturity, advancing our Azure Landing Zone, and enabling secure, scalable cloud solutions across the enterprise. You will partner closely with our Cloud Architect and Enterprise Architecture teams to operationalize cloud standards and deliver reusable engineering patterns. This role combines hands-on engineering with platform ownership, mentorship, and influence on the future direction of our cloud environment. This is a platform engineering role focused on building and evolving the Azure foundation—not just supporting individual application workloads. At WoodmenLife, you’ll also enjoy a culture that values people as much as technology. With Friday afternoons off year-round, a collaborative environment, and a focus on outcomes rather than hours, you’ll find a workplace designed to support both professional impact and personal well-being.

About the Team This role is a core contributor of WoodmenLife’s Cloud Center of Excellence (CoE) as part of the Systems Engineering organization. The Cloud CoE (led by the Cloud Architect) defines standards, guardrails, and platform direction, while the Systems Engineering team provides the delivery and operational foundation for the Azure platform. As a Cloud Engineer III, you will bridge strategy and execution—owning platform engineering outcomes while helping operationalize the enterprise cloud model.

Role Summary The Cloud Engineer III is a senior platform engineer responsible for designing, building, and evolving WoodmenLife’s Azure cloud platform. This role owns key platform domains, operationalizes cloud standards and guardrails, and delivers secure, scalable, and automated solutions that support enterprise modernization.

What You’ll Do Cloud Engineering & Platform Delivery

  • Lead design and engineering of complex Microsoft Azure platform solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards
  • Own and evolve one or more Azure platform domains such as identity, networking, governance, or DevOps pipelines

  • Collaborate with Cloud Architects, Enterprise Architects, and cross-functional stakeholders to implement and operationalize approved platform standards, engineering patterns, and cloud guardrails

Monitoring, Cost Optimization & Observability

  • Enhance cloud observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and App Insights to improve proactive detection and response
  • Implement cost optimization and financial transparency practices aligned to business outcomes, including tagging, budgeting, and usage analytics
  • Lead efforts to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud resource utilization and platform performance

Automation, DevOps & Enablement

  • Lead development of CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and modern Git-based workflows
  • Build automation frameworks that streamline provisioning, monitoring, and operational tasks, leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Azure AI services) to improve development efficiency and code quality
  • Develop reusable templates, scripts, and modules to support scalable, self-service platform capabilities and enable development teams through standardized patterns
  • Embed governance controls, policy enforcement, and configuration management into automation workflows

Collaboration, Leadership & Mentoring

  • Mentor Systems Engineers and technical peers across the organization, fostering a culture of learning, collaboration, and high performance
  • Support Agile ceremonies and iterative delivery culture for cloud initiatives
  • Contribute to the Cloud Center of Excellence through knowledge sharing, documentation, tooling, and best practices

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Implement Azure governance controls (Azure Policy, RBAC, resource organization)
  • Ensure secure-by-default configurations aligned with enterprise security standards
  • Support identity governance through Entra ID and least-privilege models

Resilience, Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery

  • Lead planning and implementation of cloud-based Business Continuity and DR strategies
  • Implement resilient, highly available solutions leveraging availability zones, automated failover, and cloud-native backup strategies

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate emerging Azure capabilities, including AI and automation technologies, and recommend platform enhancements that improve engineering productivity and platform maturity
  • Provide technical guidance and advocacy for cloud engineering best practices, automation-first patterns, and modern architectural approaches

What You Bring Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred
  • 10+ years of progressive IT infrastructure or platform engineering experience, including recent, sustained hands-on experience designing and operating enterprise-scale Azure environments
  • Deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Bicep preferred; strong scripting and automation experience required)
  • Advanced Windows/Linux, Entra ID/AD, and hybrid networking background
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and modern Git-based workflows
  • Proven experience with cloud cost management, observability, and performance optimization
  • Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring skills
  • Extensive governance experience (Azure Policy, RBAC, tagging standards)
  • Expertise with hybrid connectivity technologies (ExpressRoute, VPN, Private Endpoints)
  • Experience supporting modernization, migration, and automation initiatives
  • Exposure to Azure-native application hosting patterns (App Services, Functions, or AKS) preferred
  • Strong preference for candidates with recent, hands-on Azure platform engineering experience in enterprise environments
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) or Azure-native AI capabilities is a plus

Scope & Decision Authority

  • Own defined Azure platform domains (e.g., identity, networking, governance, DevOps pipelines) with accountability for engineering quality and outcomes
  • Make design and implementation decisions for cloud solutions within established enterprise standards and cloud guardrails
  • Operationalize architectural direction provided by the Cloud Architect through scalable, reusable engineering solutions
  • Influence platform evolution by providing engineering feedback, prototyping solutions, and identifying improvement opportunities
  • Promote and implement standardized engineering patterns, automation frameworks, and Infrastructure as Code practices
  • Identify and lead resolution of platform-level issues related to performance, cost, reliability, and security
  • Provide engineering input into prioritization of cloud platform work aligned to enterprise modernization and business outcomes
  • Focus on platform engineering and scalable solutions rather than ticket-driven operational work

Preferred Certifications

We are seeking a seasoned Microservices Architect to lead the design and evolution of large-scale microservices ecosystems built on modern container platforms and cloud-native technology stacks. The role requires deep expertise in service decomposition, domain-driven design, distributed data management, and runtime concerns such as resilience, observability, and security at scale.
